svg.text: ULTRA-HIGH-TEMPERATURE GRAPHITIZATION FURNACES: ACHESON VS. LWG (2,800 - 3,000 °C)
Synthetic Anode Stage 3: Indirect Resistor-Bed Batch Heating (12.50 kWh/kg) vs. Direct Axial Joule Heating (7.40 kWh/kg | ANL-22/74 Table 2)
BASIS: 1,000 kg FINISHED cSPG (24,300 kg ROM ORE)
CAD SECTION VIEW A-A | P&ID INSTRUMENTED

g.text: A. TRADITIONAL BATCH ACHESON RESISTANCE FURNACE (INDIRECT COKE-BED HEATING)
OFF-GAS HOOD: CO(g) + SO2(g) + SiO(g) Volatiles to Scrubber
UNDER-BED CONVECTIVE AIR-COOLING CHANNELS (Prevents Concrete Foundation Meltdown)
TOP THERMAL INSULATION BLANKET (250 mm SiO2 Sand + SiC + Coke Breeze)
Parasitic Side-Reaction at 1,700°C: SiO2(s) + 3C(s) -> beta-SiC(s) + 2CO(g) (Consumes Energy)
METALLURGICAL COKE RESISTOR PACKING BED (Indirect Heating: Q = I^2 * R_bed)
Steep Radial Delta-T (~250 °C Core-to-Wall Gradient) -> Batch-to-Batch d002 Variance
BOTTOM SILICON CARBIDE & SAND BED (300 mm Thermal Barrier above Concrete Floor)
ACHESON BATCH OPERATING LEDGER (ANL-22/74 TABLE 2; SUROVTSEVA 2022):
• Stage 3 Electricity: 12.50 kWh/kg (90.6% of total 13.79 kWh/kg Synthetic Acheson Route)
• Thermal Efficiency: ~28 - 32% (~70% heat wasted in 3:1 resistor coke & sand pack; 12-18 day cycle)
• Coal-Grid Footprint: 19.65 kg CO2e/kg (Inner Mongolia) vs. 4.60 kg CO2e/kg (Hydro Grid) | Cost: +$2,100/t
B. LONGITUDINAL GRAPHITIZATION FURNACE — LWG / CASTNER (DIRECT JOULE HEATING)
Closed Hood + Low-Flow N2/Ar Blanket (Minimizes Carbon Oxidation Loss)
MODULAR SEGMENTED SHELL (3 - 5 Day Fast Cooling & Automated Crane Discharge)
STATIONARY CARBON BLACK INSULATION BLANKET (Low k_th = 0.4 W/m·K)
ZERO INTER-CRUCIBLE RESISTOR COKE BED -> Eliminates 40.8% Parasitic Thermal Mass!
DIRECT AXIAL DC CURRENT (I = 80 - 150 kA THROUGH ANODE COLUMN)
Self-Heating: q''' = J^2 * rho(T) | Uniform Axial Temp (2,900 ± 40 °C)
Graphite Box-Crucibles act as the electrical conductor (No resistor bed)
REUSABLE GRAPHITE FOIL & CARBON BLACK BASE INSULATION (250 mm)
LWG / CASTNER OPERATING LEDGER (SUROVTSEVA ET AL. 2022; IEA 2024):
• Stage 3 Electricity: 7.40 kWh/kg (-40.8% vs. Acheson | Total Route: 8.69 kWh/kg, -37.0%)
• Thermal Efficiency: ~50 - 60% (Direct Joule heating of column; rapid 3-5 day turnover)
• Coal-Grid Footprint: 12.40 kg CO2e/kg (-36.9% vs. Acheson) vs. 2.90 kg CO2e/kg (Hydro) | Cost: +$1,250/t
Zone I: 800 - 1,350 °C | Calcination & Pitch Binder Coking
• Coal-tar pitch (150 kg/t) carbonizes; C-H volatiles (CH4, H2) evolve.
• Stage 1-2 Inputs: 1.288 kWh/kg elec + 8.69 MJ/kg natural gas/fuel oil.
• Irreversible expansion as thiophenic S & N2 erupt (CS2, H2S, SO2).
• Requires low-S needle coke (<0.5% S) + Fe2O3 puffing inhibitor.
Zone III: 2,000 - 2,500 °C | Thermal Ash Volatilization (No HF!)
• Metallic & silicate impurities (Fe, Si, Al, Ca, V) boil off as vapors.
• Intrinsic purity reaches >= 99.95% C with zero chemical acid waste.
• Crystallite L_c grows 2->45 nm; unlocks 355-365 mAh/g LiC6 capacity.
2. SPECIFIC ENERGY PARTITION (PER kg SYNTHETIC ANODE)
Acheson Batch: 12.50 kWh/kg (45.0 MJ/kg Electrical Input)
GRID CARBON SENSITIVITY & SYNTHETIC ANODE LCA (HYPOTHESIS H1 VERIFIED)
Why Grid Electricity Mix Governs Synthetic Graphite Climate Impact:
• Graphitization consumes 90.6% (Acheson) to 85.2% (LWG) of all synthetic route electricity.
• 1. Inner Mongolia Coal Grid (~1,050 g CO2e/kWh): Acheson = 19.65 kg CO2e/kg | LWG = 12.40 kg CO2e/kg
• 2. US Average Grid Mix (~380 g CO2e/kWh): Acheson = 8.90 kg CO2e/kg | LWG = 5.95 kg CO2e/kg
• 3. Sichuan / Nordic Hydro (~25 g CO2e/kWh): Acheson = 4.60 kg CO2e/kg | LWG = 2.90 kg CO2e/kg (-85%!)
• Residual ~2.6-2.9 kg CO2e/kg floor on 100% hydro comes from direct process CO2 during baking/calcination
and upstream petroleum needle coke production (Surovtseva et al. 2022; ANL-22/74 Table 2).
AUDIT METRICS: Acheson: 12.50 kWh/kg (eff ~30%) | LWG: 7.40 kWh/kg (eff ~55%, -40.8%)
PRIMARY PROVENANCE: ANL GREET ANL-22/74 Table 2; Surovtseva (2022); IEA (2024)
